title: SkillCome: Group Contrast Skill Optimization with Dual Memory
abstract: arXiv:2609.37128v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skill evolution improves the capabilities of large language models by analyzing trajectories generated under a given skill and modifying the skill accordingly. Existing approaches typically generate a single trajectory per question. However, this provides insufficient optimization signals since it requires inferring effective skill edits from a solitary path. It is difficult to pinpoint which actions caused the failure in a failed trajectory, or to determine which actions in a successful one should be incorporated into the skill. Furthermore, they rely on a local batch of trajectories for analysis, making the optimization direction susceptible to noisy evidence. To address these, we propose SkillCome, a Skill-evolution method based on group Contrast optimization with dual memory. translated_title: SkillCome：基于双记忆的组对比技能优化
translated_abstract: 技能演化通过分析在给定技能下生成的轨迹并相应地修改技能，从而提升大语言模型的能力。现有方法通常针对每个问题只生成单条轨迹，但这提供的优化信号不足，因为需要从孤立的一条路径中推断有效的技能编辑。在失败的轨迹中，难以精确定位是哪些动作导致了失败；在成功的轨迹中，也难以确定哪些动作应当被纳入技能。此外，这些方法依赖于局部的一批轨迹进行分析，使得优化方向容易受到噪声证据的影响。为解决这些问题，我们提出了SkillCome，一种基于组对比优化与双记忆的技能演化方法。对于每个问题，SkillCome生成多条轨迹并进行组对比分析，以精确识别成功与（失败轨迹之间的关键行为差异……）
tldr: SkillCome通过为每个问题生成多条轨迹并进行组对比分析，结合双记忆机制，精确识别成功与失败轨迹之间的关键行为差异，从而克服单轨迹信号不足和局部批次噪声的缺陷，实现更有效的技能演化。
en_tdlr: SkillCome leverages group contrast analysis over multiple trajectories per question with dual memory to precisely identify key behavioral divergences between successful and failed trajectories, enabling more effective skill evolution.
